column2: Take your forces East and try and stabilize the situation.
Jozefow
Serock
Makow Mazowiecki
Glinojeck
Raciaz
Allied Forces try to hold the strategic Fulda Gap against strong Soviet pressure.
We hope you're good in maths, 'cause you're not in strategy, Comrade Stalin has ordered you to count the trees in Siberia...
You have failed miserably.  Rommel remains dominant in North Africa and Egypt is now sure to fall. Report for reassignment immediately!
WWII ½: Parry - June 25, 1945
General, since we've stabilized the front in our sector, GHQ wants us to assist our British friends to the north.
Ivan's taken advantage of the favorable terrain up there, and driven the Brits back to the Rhine.
G2 has identified a weak spot on the Russian flank that I want you to
exploit.
Punch through and get to the Russian MSR.  If we hold that ground,
Ivan will have to halt his drive West to deal with it.
July 1, 1945
US forces continue their counter attack against the Soviet flank.
That was an unmitigated disaster.
If we don't breakthrough Ivan's lines, the Brits will not be able to hold.
Don't disappoint me again General or you'll get a much closer view of the
enemy.
WWII ½: Counterattack-Thrust Home - July 8, 1945
General, the Soviets have finally recognized their danger.
They've fortified the area in front of you.
If we move fast, we can cut off two whole fronts.
That would change the whole nature of this war.
Don't dilly dally, drive like hell.
The French have surrendered and resistance has collapsed. Your performance has been excellent, and the Americans are thankful for your expertise.  Well done!

Commander, our expeditionary force in Belgium has encountered heavy formations of German armor. Our commanders seem incapable of coping with the new German "Blitzkrieg" tactics. Hopefully you will have better luck.
Commander, you have successfully driven back the German offensive. Once again our American allies are in your debt.
Your victory at Sidi Barrani has the enemy reeling. You must now pursue the enemy who has reformed in the vicinity of Bardia. Good luck, Commander!

Your less than spectacular performance has motivated a reevaluation of your usefulness. We have been forced to evacuate all our troops from the continent. If we did not need every man to fight, your career would be over!
Assault on Arracourt, 09/08/1944
Commander, this is going to be a tough one.  Just capture all the objectives and get us back on track.

And keep using available bombers against artillery whenever possible. Your new attack aircraft are excellent at tearing up columns of tanks. Remember to blind his forces by aggressively ripping into his reconaissance forces.
Commander, you did a good job.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  More defeats like this will finish the Germans!

Commander, excuse me, General!  You are to lead our drive into Austria. The enemy will likely protect his homeland to the last man. There are most likely powerful panzer units in the region which is close to the Yugoslavian border. Expect intervention of Tito's communist partisans in their home country.
45/CNG Const. Bttn.
Commander, this loss has perhaps cost us the war. You are to return to England to face a firing squad. It's a disaster, whole Austria might fall under Soviet hands!

General, though your performance has been competent, the decision has been made to give you a new command.  The General Staff feels it is best that if you assume command of one the weather stations in Greenland .  Bernard Montgomery will assume your duties.

Commander, now that you have helped our allies off the beach, our own troops can use your aid. Powerful German panzer units have fought our forces to a standstill at Caen. You and your crack troops will lead the breakthrough.

Very well done!  You have exceeded Churchill's hopes!  Your victory at Bardia has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Italian government has appealed to Germany for help.  Congratulations!
Very good! Metz is now ours. Once again your men have proved their superiority to the German "master race". Congratulations, Commander!
Good work. You have fulfilled Churchill's hopes!  Your attack has weakened enemy resistance.  And now, Italy will be forced to accept German help.
Commander, We have a chance to trap many German troops between us and Patton's Third Army to the south. You must move quickly to accomplish this task.
You clumsy traitor! You'll be issued to the penal battalion at Leningrad front. Maybe there you'll show your love for the communism and Motherland!!!
This is a bitter defeat. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.
Commander, you have successfully broken through the German lines. Now we must move on the Ruhr to destroy German industrial capacity.
Caging the Bear, 06/01/1945
Patton was right, we cannot trust Soviets!

Ivan expelled us from Berlin while we were in Norway. They claim that our presence in Berlin -decided at Yalta- was limited to a symbolic presence of a few regiments for the period of time needed to sign the German capitulation. Now that Germany has surrendered, they consider Berlin as a whole being part of the Soviet occupation zone.
You are to strike back, just drive the Soviets back across the Oder! We want you to force Soviets to sit at table of negotiations. Teach them a lesson Commander!

Ivan opposed a strong resistance, only the threat to use nukes force Soviets to retreat to borderlines decided at Yalta. Hopefully Stalin's researchers -despite the arrest of many German scientists- were not able to build up the bomb!
Soviets opposed a strong resistance, but you forced them to sue for peace.

They pretended it was a misunderstanding, they claim they misinterpreted Yalta's Agreements about the borderlines. They spoke about an "incident" caused by the lack of clarity of clauses discussed at Yalta. They now try to minimize the events.
Maybe the nuclear bomb dropped on Japan has played a role in the way the Kremlin understands the past agreements...

Commander, our American allies are planning an invasion of French North Africa. Because they lack experience, the Americans have asked for our help.  You will lead a joint assault on Casablanca to demonstrate our amphibious tactics. Good Luck!

Commander, I must congratulate you on this resounding success. French forces have surrendered and resistance has collapsed. You handled this difficult assignment with great skill and intelligence. You will be, no doubt, honoured when you return to England.

Commander, you have failed.  The French have successfully beaten back the Americans throughout North Africa.  We expected more from you.  You are being transferred as liaison officer to the US Army in the Aleutians.
Monte Cassino, 05/11/1944

The offensive is codenamed Operation Diadem; the plan is to break through the Gustav Line and drive towards the next line of defense, the so-called Hitler Line. The Polish 2nd Corps, with assistance of some British and Canadian units have the unenviable task of the final assault of Monte Cassino. In the southern part of the line the French Expeditionary Corps and the US 2nd Corps will attack the German mountain positions. The most difficult part is left to you.

Your part of the offensive, Operation Honker, is to break through the line and advance up the Liri valley until you reach the Hitler Line. Meanwhile, the Americans will break out of Anzio to meet you and trap the Germans between the 2 spearheads - or so we hope.
San Donato Val di Comino

The Americans have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of German to escape.

The good news is you have performed well. The bad news is that the Americans at Anzio have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of Germans to escape.

The good news is you have performed brilliantly, as usual - a textbook offensive. The Poles and the French army have performed way beyond all expectations, and the American did not do too badly either.

The bad news is the Americans at Anzio have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of Germans to escape.
You've chosen the path of Market Garden - The Battle of the Bulge - The Ruhr, good luck!!!
East Africa Invasion
Buur Gaabo
Baydhabo
You've chosen the path of Gothic Line - Austria - Eagle's nest, good luck!!!
Your failure is hard to stomach, Commander. I have nothing more to say to you.

Commander, our American allies are once again in a jam. For two days they have been pinned down on the beaches at Normandy. As our most experienced field commander, you have been chosen to lead your armored group into battle at Normandy to save our allies. We know you wil not let us down.
Well, you barely accomplished your mission, but the sea lanes are safe. You have been lucky, commander, with this narrow victory.
Monty?, please, come in.  You have heard the news?  Maybe it is best that he did not return from Normandy.  After all, the shame of utter defeat would have been too much for him to bear.
A  good performance, to be sure. Excellent. Once again the Americans owe you a debt of gratitude. The Americans may offer you honorary citizenship!
DEFENDING TOBRUK, 04/31/1941
You must hold Tobruk at all costs, there will be no withdrawal. The defense should be conducted with the utmost agression.
The loss of Tobruk has been a crushing blow to the morale of the Empire, you would do better to resign now. I am sure we can find a new command for you ... somewhere.
Rommel's initial attacks have been stopped, good work. Unfortunately you were too slow to take advantage of your deffensive sucesses.
Rommel's initial attacks have been stopped, good work. You are the best man to command our next offensive, so I have put in a good word for you.

Intelligence confirms that Hitler and other leading Nazis did not die in Berlin but escaped to Norway and not to Berchtesgaden where we had primarily expected. They are now collecting the remnants of their forces, including crack panzer units and top ace fighter pilots, to oppose any attempt to capture the Führer. Hitler's private plane waits on a nearby airfield in case he needs to escape. You leave immediately Berchtesgaden to Norway. You must destroy all command centers and Hitler's bunker. You must move quickly. More reinforcements are pouring in daily!
Comrade Marshal, you have to stop your attack! The Yanks has threatened us with use of nuclear bomb! We have to withdraw and wait for better time to complete the liberation of the Europe.
FIRST BATTLE OF EL ALAMEIN, 07/05/1942

The Axis forces have reached the El Alamein line. I am sure you are aware of the news from Russia, Germany has just launched a major offensive aimed at advancing to the Volga and into the Caucasus. After El Alamein there is nothing to stop Rommel advancing to the Nile and controlling the Suez Canal, the Allies are retreating on all fronts - we will retreat no further!
First Battle of El Alamein
Alam Halfa Ridge : HILL

Withdraw with all haste, we obviously cannot hold Rommel here. You should withdraw your men towards Cairo, we are already preparing defensive positions at Cairo and Alexandria. New equipment and supplies are on the way, but we must hold the line at the Nile.
OPERATION LIGHTFOOT, 10/23/1942

Well, following your success in East Africa, we have a mission of utmost importance. Incompetent command by your successor in Egypt has allowed Rommel and his Afrika Korps to overrun all of the territory you worked so hard to attain. Now Egypt is once again threatened. Only you can lead us to victory!

The long retreat ends today. The plan is to break through the Axis lines in the north - your men will be attacking at the strongest point, where the Axis have built strong defensive positions. Once you reach your objectives you will be able to break through their lines and stop any retreat of German and Italian forces.

We have air superiority, more men and equipment and plenty of supplies, furthermore Intelligence tells us that Rommel is in Germany on sick leave, the enemy should be easily defeated once we breach its fortifications.
Second Battle of El Alamein

That is correct, Mr Churchill, he was captured by Rommel himself, or so they say; what a shame. General Montgomery arrived here early this morning and has taken over the defense of our positions at El Alamein, all is not lost yet.
Well done. You have broken through the enemy lines, but now you will have to cut off Rommel's retreat.
The Germans have launched a major offensive in the Ardennes region in the dead of winter.  Our American allies are reeling from the blows.  Once again, you must go to their aid.
St Sauveur de Pierre Pont
Commander, this loss has perhaps cost us the war. You are to return to England to face a firing squad.
ASSAULTING THE GOTHIC LINE, 09/10/1944
I know things have been quiet for you for the last few months, but you are needed now so I hope your men are ready.

We have come up against the Gothic Line, stretching approximately east to west across Italy along the Appenines. The basic plan to break the Line calls for 3 attacks, the US army will attack in the west and centre, while our own forces will attack along the Adriatic in the east, aiming for Ravenna - this is codenamed Operation Olive.

However, you will not be part of our offensive. You are being attached to the US 5th Army, who are attacking in the centre of the line. The plan calls for a 2-pronged attack north from Florence with the objective of controlling the mountain passes, crossing the Appenines and advancing towards Bologna.

I understand your trepidation at serving under the Americans, however they are our Allies and they do need your help. They will doubtless use your men in subsidiary roles and take the glory for themselves. They do not seem to trust us as much as they should, however I trust you to work with the Americans and make us proud.
The offensive has not gone as well as we hoped. In your sector you have managed to control the passes but we still have not captured our objectives - Bologna, in particular, is still in enemy hands.

Before long we will be forced to shut down the offensives for winter and will use that time to resupply and plan for next year. In spring we hope to begin offensives to put an end to the Italian front.
GUSTAV LINE, 01/17/1944

Our advance on Rome has been delayed very skillfully by the Germans and has stopped on the Gustav line, southeast of Rome. The southern part of the line runs along the Rapido and Gargliano rivers and is centred on the area around Monte Cassino.

Your orders are to cross the Gargliano and establish a bridgehead in preparation for an offensive up the Liri Valley. Once the landings at Anzio go ahead we will be in position to quickly capture Rome.
Meanwhile, American and French forces will assault and capture the Cassino area.

Tha landings at Anzio have gone ahead as expected although our failure to penetrate the Gustav Line will have a great impact on the battle. Send you men to the rear as per your orders, you will refit and resupply in preparation for future offensives.

Commander, as you know, operation Market Garden has been given the approval of SHAEF headquarters. Our objective is to use airborne forces to capture bridges leading up the the Rhine crossing at Arnhem. You will lead the armored forces that will link up with the Airborne units. You first objective will be the bridges over the Zuid Willems Canal.
The Tenth Panzer division lies between your forces and the bridges at Arnhem. You must defeat them and continue on to Arnhem.
Commander, you have completed the first part of your mission. You must continue the thrust to Arnhem.
The German Army is holding defensive positions in the vicinity of Metz. This will be a tough assignment Commander. Hopefully you are up to the task.
You have dealt the german Army a severe blow buit you failed to reach Arnhem in time. The war will now be lengthened.
Good job, Commander. You have given the Italians a taste of defeat. You must follow up this great victory with another!
Commander, you must lead our attack into the Ruhr. This is Germany's major industrial zone. If it falls, Germany will be forced to surrender!
Commander, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain. We must fall back quickly or face annihilation. You have been ordered to London to face a firing squad.

My commendations, Commander!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well!  Your complete victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.

Commander, your narrow victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.

Commander, your victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.

The Axis-held island of Pantelleria has proved to be a thorn in our side. Aircraft from this island bastion are harassing our convoys and threaten our proposed invasion opf Sicily. You must capture the island so we can proceed with our invasion plans.
Commander, your next task is to break through German lines North of Dusseldorf. This will open the way into the heart of the Ruhr.

Commander, you are chosen to lead our forces in North Africa. The Italians have been stopped in the vicinity of Sidi Barrani, where they have established strong defensive positions. You will attack and overwhelm these defenses.

The Germans are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in capturing the Ruhr, you drove the Nazis back to Berlin. Commander, diplomatic representatives of the Allies and Germany are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and throughout Europe, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.

Commander, diplomatic representatives of the Allied Powers and Germany are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and throughout Europe, are unparalleled.... You are to return home to a grateful nation.
Commander, our invasion of Italy is proceeding ahead of schedule. Your troops will now be returned to England for some well-deserved rest. You will be recieving plenty of leave time yourself!
Commander. Even now, the Hermann Goering Division is advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.
Salerno is secure. This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at SHAEF headquarters. I am sure that you will do very well.
Salerno - Return to Europe
Congratulations!  Winston is pleased by your performance.  The capture of Sicily is almost assured. Commander, you have exceeded all expectations.
Commander, you will lead our assault on Sicily.  If Sicily falls into our hands, the Italians will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them out of the War.
Commander, you have disgraced the British Army with pitiful efforts!  Many here demand your return to England to face a court-martial.  May I suggest suicide?

Well, Commander, you have managed to establish a beachhead on Sicily after a hard fight, but the enemy were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces on the island.  Unfortunately, the battle for Sicily will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain further effort in this theater of operations.
Our Sicilian campaign has run into heavy resistance in the Simeto Valley. You job is to break the stalemate. Good luck, Commander.
Senne River
Dyle River (impassible)
Jette
Asse
Erps_Kwerps
Moorsel
Buken
Commander, you were lucky to escape that one. A very disappointing performance indeed!
Comrade General, the Wehrmacht has been crushed. Now towards Berlin; it's about 2000 km from our current positions...
Operacja Bagration - Operation "Bagration" (ZS#08), 06/22/1944

Comrade General, in the 3rd anniversary of Nazi attack on our Rodina, we shall start the greatest offensive of this war. Comrade Stalin ordered us the loudly aim of liberating the whole Byelorussia and driving the Germans away from our land!
Your successful breakthrough in the Simeto Valley has opened the way to Messina.  The entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.  Excellent work!
Comrade Komdiv, you've been awarded the posthumous Hero of the Soviet Union.
Your successful breakthrough in the Simeto Valley has opened the way to Messina.  The entire area is under our control.  Good work.

Commander, though you shamed the British Army with your miserable performance in France, the successful evacuation at Dunkirk has put Churchill in a forgiving mood.  You are given one last chance - to play an important role in our invasion of British Somaliland.  The Italians have occupied our colony sinc the beginning of the war. You must drive them out!

You have accomplished your mission, but your lack of speed has allowed the enemy to escape.  It is possible that this campaign could go on as long as the last war.  Commander, we will, no doubt, call on you again for your services.

Commander, your victory at Bardia allows us an opportunity to evict Italy from our colony in British Somaliland, which they have occupied since the beginning of the war.  Your experience in amphibious warfare should prove useful here.
Operacja Berlinska - Assault on Berlin (ZS#13), 04/16/1945
Comrade General, Berlin aheads! Kill the Nazi Beast in its lair!!!
Playing tip : Bridge layer unit allows you not only to cross rivers but also to deploy units wherever you move, close to or behind enemy lines for instance.

Comrade, thanks to the leadership of the Great Stalin your troops has thrown the German Army back from the gates of Moscow, but that's only the beginning. We still think you'll be sent back to the Gulag, but Zhukov has good opinoion on you, so you'll be given another chance. On his request you've been promoted to the rank of Komdiv, but we in the Political Directorate will keep an eye on you.

Comrade, thanks to the leadership of the Great Stalin your troops has thrown the German Army back from the gates of Moscow, but that's only the beginning. We still think you'll be sent back to the Gulag, but Zhukov has good opinion on you, so you'll be given another chance. On his request you've been promoted to the rank of Komdiv, but we in the Political Directorate will keep an eye on you.

Comrade, this brilliant victory was achieved due to the superiority of Communism over the Nazism. Now we shall pursue these scums to the Berlin and liberate the working people in the whole Europe! In appreciation to your merits you've been promoted to General of Tank Troops. Hail the Soviet Union!

You're not worth to be "comrade". Comrade Stalin ordered to assault, but you were so slow and clumsy, that Nazis could regroup and counterattack. You should have been courtmartialled but at the last minute Comrade Stalin decided to grant you a last chance. This humble gesture won't happen twice.
Klin - kontrofensywa zimowa/Klin-winter counteroffensive

Comrade General, now, after there are no german troops on the Ukraine, you'll be commanded to Byelorussia. From there we shall make a decisive blow to drive the fascist invaders away from Rodina! For liberation of the Ukraine you've been decorated with the Order of the Red Banner.

Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created. Afterwards, for your combat achievements, you were promoted to Army General and decorated with Order of the Kutuzov.
Well, this attack was not very succesful. Another mistake and you'll be counting trees in Siberia...

Comrade General, your pursuit has led us to the Middle Oder! Now there's only 60 km to the Berlin!!! The intelligence claims that these fortifications you've crossed nearly away, were said to be the strongest defence positions in the East. We would have never think about it in that way...
Get in, you scum, next station - Kolyma!
Well, comrade general, this schnaps is ooouughh quite good, and the fraulein, whatsoever, also nice... Twelve times before stopped to move, uyhhpfg...
[Bang!!]
Excuse us, comrade, but Your aide-de-camp has been dismissed for drinking on duty...
For taking Berlin You have been promoted to the Marshal of the Soviet Union and decorated with the Order of Victory. Hail to the Soviet Union and the Great Stalin!!!
Good morning Sir, I hope you want to stay in the U.S. for long?

Comrade Marshal, unfortunately you have to stop further attack. The Americans has threatened us with the use of nuclear weapons. Our socialist Motherland can't afford the next war now. Comrade Beria has been given an order to build the Soviet A-bomb in 4 years, or else... Then you'll be able to finish the started cause of liberation the working class of the Europe and the whole world...! For now we're establishing GDR and Warsaw Pact. And for you, for consolation, third Star of the Hero of the Soviet Union, comfortable residence, personal distillery and sturgeon fish-culture for caviar. Hurrrah! Long live the Peace!!! (not for long... ;-))

Comrade Kombrig, Comrade Stalin agreed to let you return to the army. You have been freed from the Labor Camp, but don't think the Party has forgotten your Trotzkist deviation. You have been given back your previous rank, but before you start any celebration you have to keep in mind you must vindicate your good name by your actions in the war. The Nazi scumbags stand at the gates of Moscow; however we're preparing counteroffensive to strike them back. You'll serve under Zhukov's command. If you fail, the Hand of our Communist Justice shall grab on you!!!
Woronez - Voronezh (ZS#04), 01/12/1943

Comrade General! Comrade Stalin, on Zhukov's proposal, has charged you with a task of leading an operation to destroy 2nd Hungarian and remnants of 8th Italian armies. Your aim is to cut off the 2nd German Army on the Voronezh Bridgehead and going to the back of Army Group South. Nothing can stop us!
Ofensywa Styczniowa - Operation "Vistula-Oder"
Wal Pomorski - "Pommernstellung" (ZS#12), 03/01/1945

Comrade General, on our northern flank there is still danger of counterattack from the Western Pomerania. STAVKA has orderded you to support the offensive of 1st Polish Army and to establish the front line along the Oder. After then, we shall assault on Berlin!!!
